title: 第10章 长大了第11章 锦书阁关张
slug: 凡人修仙我只是个路人甲
content_zh:
“哼”，香儿也没拿乔，干脆利落的上了马车，只觉得看门的仆人耽误自己时间了。
车夫听见放行，就挥着鞭子赶着马车进去了。
不一会功夫，角门就又来了一辆马车，仆人又重复之前的步骤检查一番，放人进去。
这李家一天到晚进出的人可真不少。
侧门没有人进出，但也有门人在值班。
接着绕，就到了李府后门，后门比起侧门和角门来，明显小得多，只能一次进入一辆马车。
当然，后门进出的大多不是马车，而是板车，进去的板车上放着时蔬、肉食，甚至还有从府里运出来的泔水桶，粪桶等。
而且也有人在负责检查，虽然没有问送的是什么。
但是蔬菜运进去要扎成捆，垒成摞，酒水要放在坛子里。
总之就是人不能待的地方，以确保不会混进去别有用心的人。
林鹤清算是知道，为什么小说电视剧里都要在里面安插眼线了，就这检查力度，想送一个没有身份的人进去太难了。
林鹤清深刻的体会到了“宰相门前三品官”的感觉了。
林鹤清绕了一大圈的结果就是，李府一共有一个大门，很大但是不开。
两个角门，分别是东角门和西角门，大多数是帮主子们买东西的仆人侍妾等人走。
一个侧门，家里的主子们出行大多走侧门。
还有一个后门，大多是每天不同的农户负责送菜之类的。
李府的看完了，天就已经有些暗了，林鹤清还没吃午饭，此时肚已经饿的不得了，决定稍微看看王家的情况就先回去。
与李府的严格检查不同，王家的门子不仅不仔细检查进出的人和东西，还两面人。
如果进出的是主子的或者是得宠的侍妾的仆人，门子则不仅不会仔细检查，还会在出入的人面前露个脸，和他们说些好话。
而出入的是不得宠的人院里的，则是想法子克扣卡要，说话也毫不客气，被压榨的人也没办法，面上是麻木无奈。

看来王家管教不严阿，迟早要完，林鹤清心里想。
林鹤清走的飞快，终于在天黑之前回到客栈。
林鹤清和店小二说要一碗面，吃了就上去了。
不是林鹤清喜欢吃面条，也不是客栈里只有面条。
主要是林鹤清一个小孩，点一个菜也吃不完，加上菜的价钱也不便宜，每天吃几顿手里的钱就要不够了。
今天是六月十三，还有两天就到去李府的日子了，不知道林鹤清能顺利进去嘛。
进入房间后，林鹤清锁好门，直接进空间了。
他没管其他的东西，直接坐在蒲团上闭上眼睛开始修炼。
不停重复的跟着口诀，就是没法内视自己，完成一周天的循环。
一直练到肚子“咕噜噜”得声音把他唤醒，他才睁开眼睛，今天他的眼睛睁开后没有迷茫，只有惊喜。
content_en:
"Humph", Xiang'er didn't take Qiao and simply got on the carriage. She felt that the servant at the door was wasting her time.
When the coachman heard the permission, he waved his whip and drove the carriage in.
After a while, another carriage came to the corner gate. The servant repeated the previous steps to check and let people in.
There are quite a few people coming in and out of the Li family all day long.
No one was entering or exiting the side door, but there was a doorman on duty.
Then we went around and arrived at the back door of Li Mansion. The back door was significantly smaller than the side door and corner door, and could only allow one carriage to enter at a time.
Of course, most of the people who come in and out of the back door are not horse-drawn carriages, but carts. On the carts, there are seasonal vegetables, meat, and even swill buckets and dung buckets transported from the house.
There was also someone checking, although they didn't ask what was delivered.
However, when the vegetables are brought in, they must be bundled and stacked, and the wine must be placed in jars.
In short, it is a place where people are not allowed to stay, to ensure that no one with ulterior motives will get in.
Lin Heliang knew why novels and TV shows had spies inside. With the intensity of the inspection, it would be too difficult to send an unidentified person in.
Lin Heqing deeply felt the feeling of "a third-rank official in front of the prime minister's door".
The result of Lin Heqing's detour was that there was one gate in Li's Mansion, which was large but could not be opened.
There are two corner gates, namely the east corner gate and the west corner gate. Most of them are servants, concubines and others who help the masters buy things.
A side door. The masters of the house mostly use the side door when traveling.
There is also a back door, and most of them are delivered by different farmers every day.
After finishing reading the Li Mansion, it was already getting dark. Lin Heqing hadn't had lunch yet and was already extremely hungry. He decided to go back first after checking out the Wang family's situation.
Unlike the Li Mansion's strict inspection, the Wang family's gatekeepers not only did not carefully check the people and things coming in and out, but they were also two-faced.
If the person coming in or out is the servant of the master or a favored concubine, the servant will not only not check carefully, but will also show his face in front of the people coming in and out and say nice things to them.
Those who come in and out of the courtyard are those who are not favored, and they try to find ways to get what they want, and they are not polite in their words. The people who are being exploited have no choice but to look numb and helpless on their faces.
It seems that the Wang family's discipline is not strict, and it will be over sooner or later, Lin Heqing thought to himself.
Lin Heqing walked quickly and finally returned to the inn before dark.
Lin Heqing told the waiter that he wanted a bowl of noodles and went up to eat.
It's not that Lin Heqing likes noodles, and it's not that the only food in the inn is noodles.
The main reason is that Lin Heqing is a child and can't finish a dish he orders. In addition, the prices of the dishes are not cheap, so he doesn't have enough money to eat a few meals a day.
Today is June 13th, and there are only two days until the day to go to Li Mansion. I wonder if Lin Heqing can get in smoothly.
After entering the room, Lin Heqing locked the door and entered the space directly.
He didn't care about anything else, just sat on the futon, closed his eyes and started practicing.
If you keep following the mantra over and over again, you won’t be able to look inside yourself and complete the daily cycle.
He didn't open his eyes until the sound of his stomach "gurgling" woke him up. Today, when he opened his eyes, he was not confused, only surprised.
